[[ ## question ## ]]
What government position was held by the woman who portrayed Corliss Archer in the film Kiss and Tell?

[[ ## context ## ]]
Kiss and Tell (1945 film): Kiss and Tell is a 1945 American comedy film starring then 17-year-old Shirley Temple as Corliss Archer.
Shirley Temple: Shirley Temple Black (April 23, 1928 – February 10, 2014) was an American actress, singer, dancer, businesswoman, and diplomat who was Hollywood's number one box-office draw as a child actress from 1935 to 1938.
Shirley Temple: As an adult, she was named United States ambassador to Ghana and to Czechoslovakia
Shirley Temple: also served as Chief of Protocol of the United States.

[[ ## draft ## ]]
mayor

[[ ## critique ## ]]
The answer is incorrect; the position was a United States ambassador to Ghana and to Czechoslovakia.
